d:
Jammu-kashmir ke shringar men sthit lal chauk par kuchh logon ne divali manaee, is dauran kari suraksha vyavastha dekhne ko mili. isse pahle kuchh logon ne durga puja aur dashahra bhi manaya tha. dusri taraf kashmir men rahne vale kaee musalmanon ka kahna hai ki eed ke mauke par kisi na kisi vajah se eedgah aur jamiya masjid ko band kar diya jata hai. in ghatnaon ke bad, sthaniy nivasiyon ne kashmir men dharmik svatantrata, sarvajnik sthanon ke istemal aur sarkar ke dohre mapdandon ko lekar saval uthae hain.
Riportar: gafira qadir
Shut shabbir ahmad
Editing shafat faruq
